entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This petition is filed for setting aside the order dated 01.11.2022 passed by the learned Trial Court in case FIR No.134/2012 under Section 498A/406/34 IPC and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act registered at police station Jafrabad, Delhi.

2. The learned counsel for petitioner submits the petitioner / complainant is unable to appear before the learned Trial Court on 28.01.2023 for her evidence because of her minor 11 months old child and have Bailable Warrants be cancelled against her, she being the complainant.
3. In the circumstances explained, the Bailable Warrants issued in the sum of Rs.10,000/- issued by the learned Trial Court against petitioner herein per order dated 01.11.2022 stands cancelled.

The petitioner is exempted from appearance before the learned Trial Court on date already fixed i.e.
28.01.2023 because of her 11months old child.
4. The counsel for petitioner however undertake the petitioner shall positively appear before the learned Trial Court for her evidence in the month of March, 2023.
Accordingly, the learned Trial Court is requested to post the matter for evidence of the petitioner in the month of March, 2023.
5. The petition stands disposed of in above terms.
Pending application, if any, also stands disposed of.
6. Copy of this order be communicated to the learned Trial Court for information and compliance.
